episodes.synopsis: A photographer with an interest in spirits and ghosts pays a visit to the very strange and creepy home where the six Hikizuri siblings live.
episodes.title: The Strange Hikizuri Siblings

episodes.synopsis: Goro returns to the tunnel he saw his mother once walk into. An ice cream truck arrives in the neighborhood, driven by a bewitching young man.
episodes.title: The Story of the Mysterious Tunnel / Ice Cream Bus

episodes.synopsis: After a popular idol dies by what appears to be suicide, there are multiple sightings of her giant, grotesque head floating in the sky.
episodes.title: Hanging Balloon

episodes.synopsis: Koichi can’t study because his younger brother Soichi is constantly making noise. Tormented by his dreams, Yuji asks his friend Mari to keep him awake.
episodes.title: Four x Four Walls / The Sandman's Lair

episodes.synopsis: Oshikiri has been hearing strange footsteps in the house he lives in alone. Chiemi wakes up to find a rat stuck in her long, black hair.
episodes.title: Intruder / Long Hair in the Attic

episodes.synopsis: A year after renting his house to Mr. Rogi, Akasaka finds mold growing everywhere. Koko's husband Goro is obsessed with maintaining his library.
episodes.title: Mold / Library Vision

episodes.synopsis: After hitting a girl with his car, Tsuyoshi and his sister Kaoru find that the road they're driving on is blocked by countless tombstones.
episodes.title: Tomb Town

episodes.synopsis: When an accident causes her to lose half her face, Reimi discovers that her younger selves still exist inside her. An eerie sea creature drifts ashore.
episodes.title: Layers of Terror / The Thing that Drifted Ashore

episodes.synopsis: A menacing transfer student named Tomie isn't happy that a girl named Tsukiko has been taking and selling pictures of popular boys in their school.
episodes.title: Tomie・Photo

episodes.synopsis: Two friends get lost in the mountains and come across a community of ascetic monks. Kuriko ends up bullying a younger boy she's been playing with.
episodes.title: Unendurable Labyrinth / The Bully

episodes.synopsis: A young man moves into a boarding house next to an enclosed alley. An art teacher known for his headless sculptures is found murdered — with no head.
episodes.title: Alley / Headless Statue

episodes.synopsis: A mysterious woman calmly takes on the job of helping a hysterical girl unable to make any decisions on her own. Soichi’s family adopts a pet cat.
episodes.title: Whispering Woman / Soichi's Beloved Pet
